blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has tightened its procedures for tax refund claims, with the 180-day processing period starting only after taxpayers submit complete documentary requirements. Under Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 102-2026, the BIR clarified the mandatory requirements for claims involving excess or unutilized creditable withholding taxes (CWT). The BIR said individuals or corporations may either request a refund of their excess income taxes or carry over the amount to succeeding taxable years.
